record.label: T-gate savings in inner state preparation and SELECT
record.statement: Inner state preparation uses a 126-qubit one-hot register for the square index and a 5-bit binary register for the inner index. The authors attribute 96% of the T gates saved per walk step in Table S3 to the changes in inner state preparation and SELECT.
record.boundary: Table S3 compares the baseline with a step in the first eight blocks of the verified circuit. The reduction in T gates for rotations and angles and inner state preparation is 17,676 out of a total of 18,398. The overall spacetime cost also depends on the number of qubits and walk steps.
